description: This file implements a simple assertion testing library with functions for asserting equality and inequality, plus a test runner that executes test functions and reports results.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Asserts that two values are equal using a custom comparison function.

methods.name: nassert
methods.description: Asserts that two values are not equal using a custom comparison function.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs a test case, which can be a named or anonymous function, and reports the number of passed assertions.
